mentions.name: dbmuse
mentions.description: A visual GUI for MongoDB and Postgres on macOS that includes an AI agent for asking questions about your database. Windows and Linux support plus MCP integration are planned, so Claude Code and other LLMs can use the local database as a tool.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://www.dbmuse.com a visual GUI for Mongo and Postgres with an Agent to ask questions about your DB for macOS. Soon also for Windows/Linux and with MCP support to let Claude Code/other LLM use your local database as a tool.
